entities.name: José Luis López-Aranguren
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis López-Aranguren Jiménez, who signed his works as José Luis L. Aranguren, was a Spanish philosopher and essayist. He was a leading figure in 20th-century Spanish thought and taught ethics at the Complutense University of Madrid. His work combined ethical, political, and religious reflection, warning against the dangers of a purely techno-scientific society lacking solidarity and humanism.
